# BrightMolar (toothcare recreation) — Design & Task Notes

## Source Mapping

- **ColorLib Source**: `toothcare` (`https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/toothcare/`)
- **New App Name**: `brightmolar` (`@free-react-templates/brightmolar`)
- **Category**: Healthcare / Dental Clinic

## Design Notes

- **Color Palette**: Clean clinical cyan (`#00bcd4`), white (`#ffffff`), soft neutral light gray (`#f8f9fa`), and dark charcoal text (`#212529`).
- **Typography**: Sans-serif (Roboto), clean hierarchy.
- **Key Sections**:
  1. Navbar with sticky/light style and booking CTA.
  2. Hero slider banner.
  3. Appointment booking interactive form + service highlights.
  4. Services grid (8 core dental services).
  5. Intro banner & stats counter (3000+ patients, 2200+ surgeries, 24/7).
  6. Dentist team cards with social links.
  7. Testimonials carousel & treatment results.
  8. Blog posts & pricing tiers.
  9. Footer with Component Dock attribution.
